vocabulary.meaning: Nút hoãn báo thức / Giấc ngủ ngắn

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: You look so tired this morning. Did you sleep well?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Not really. My alarm clock goes off at 6 AM, but I always hit snooze.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Haha, I do that too! Do you have time for breakfast?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: No, I usually skip breakfast and rush to the office.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's not good for your health. You should change that habit.

story.text: Every morning, Ben struggles to wake up early. When his alarm clock goes off at 6 AM, he always hits the snooze button. Because of this, he usually skips breakfast and rushes straight to the office, which makes him look very tired.

questions.question: What time does the alarm clock go off?
questions.suggested_answer: It goes off at 6 AM.

questions.question: What does Ben do when the alarm rings?
questions.suggested_answer: He always hits the snooze button.

questions.question: Does Ben eat breakfast in the morning?
questions.suggested_answer: No, he usually skips breakfast.

questions.question: Why does Ben rush to the office?
questions.suggested_answer: Because he wakes up late after hitting snooze.

lessons.title: Inviting a Friend to a Party

dialogue.speaker: Lisa
dialogue.text: Hey Mark, I'm hosting a housewarming party this Saturday.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.text: Oh, dynamic! Are you celebrating your new apartment?

dialogue.speaker: Lisa
dialogue.text: Yes! Can you make it? It starts around 6 PM.

dialogue.speaker: Mark
dialogue.text: I'd love to come! Should I bring anything?

dialogue.speaker: Lisa
dialogue.text: Just bring yourself and some good mood!

story.text: Lisa hosts a housewarming party this Saturday to celebrate her new apartment. She invites her friend Mark to join. Mark says he loves to come and asks if he should bring anything. Lisa smiles and tells him to just bring himself.

questions.question: When does the party take place?
questions.suggested_answer: It takes place this Saturday around 6 PM.

questions.question: What is Lisa celebrating?
questions.suggested_answer: She is celebrating her new apartment.

questions.question: What does Lisa ask Mark to bring?
questions.suggested_answer: She tells him to just bring himself.

vocabulary.meaning: Sự hoàn tiền / Hoàn lại tiền
Hóa đơn mua hàng, biên lai

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.text: Excuse me, I bought this blender yesterday, but it is damaged.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.text: I am sorry to hear that. Do you have the receipt with you?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.text: Yes, here it is. I want to get a full refund, please.

dialogue.speaker: Clerk
dialogue.text: Our store policy allows refunds within 7 days, so that's no problem.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.text: Thank you, I appreciate your quick help.

story.text: A customer goes back to the shop because his new blender is damaged. He shows the receipt to the clerk and requests a full refund. The clerk explains that the store policy allows returns within 7 days, so he happily processes the request.

questions.question: What item did the customer buy yesterday?
questions.suggested_answer: He bought a blender.

questions.question: What is wrong with the blender?
questions.suggested_answer: It is damaged.

questions.question: Does the customer have the receipt?
questions.suggested_answer: Yes, he has it with him.

questions.question: What is the store's refund policy?
questions.suggested_answer: It allows refunds within 7 days.

dialogue.speaker: Husband
dialogue.text: Honey, what are we making for dinner tonight?

dialogue.speaker: Wife
dialogue.text: Let's try a new pasta recipe. Do we have all the ingredients?

dialogue.speaker: Husband
dialogue.text: Yes, we have tomatoes, garlic, and beef. How can I help?

dialogue.speaker: Wife
dialogue.text: Can you chop the vegetables while I stir the sauce?

dialogue.speaker: Husband
dialogue.text: Sure! Wow, the sauce smells amazing already.

story.text: A couple decides to try a new pasta recipe for dinner. They check and see that they have all the necessary ingredients like tomatoes and garlic. The husband chops the vegetables while the wife stirs the sauce, which smells amazing already.

dialogue.speaker: Interviewer

dialogue.text: Great. What do you consider your biggest strength?

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.text: Good morning, passport and ticket, please.

dialogue.speaker: Traveler
dialogue.text: Here you go. I also need to check this luggage.

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.text: Please place it on the scale. Good, it's not overweight. Here is your boarding pass.

dialogue.speaker: Traveler
dialogue.text: Thank you. What gate is it?

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.text: Gate 12. But please note that the flight is delayed by thirty minutes.

story.text: A traveler checks in his luggage at the airport counter. The agent weighs the bag on the scale and confirms it is fine. She hands him his boarding pass and points him to Gate 12, but warns him that the flight is delayed by thirty minutes.

dialogue.speaker: Pharmacist
dialogue.text: Hello, how can I help you feel better today?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.text: Hi, I need some strong painkillers for my backache.

dialogue.speaker: Pharmacist
dialogue.text: Take one pill after each meal. Also, be careful because it makes you drowsy.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.text: Oh, thanks for the warning. Can I drive after taking it?

dialogue.speaker: Pharmacist
dialogue.text: No, you shouldn't drive. It's safer to rest at home.

story.text: A customer goes to the pharmacy to get some painkillers for his backache. The pharmacist explains the dosage: one pill after each meal. She also warns him that the medicine makes him drowsy, so he must not drive a car after taking it.

questions.question: What kind of medicine does the customer need?
questions.suggested_answer: He needs some strong painkillers.

questions.question: What is the correct dosage?
questions.suggested_answer: One pill after each meal.

questions.question: What is the side effect of the medicine?
questions.suggested_answer: It makes the customer feel drowsy.

questions.question: Can the customer drive after taking the pill?
questions.suggested_answer: No, he shouldn't drive.

dialogue.speaker: Sister
dialogue.text: Hey, are you doing your laundry now? Can you wash my shirt too?

dialogue.speaker: Brother
dialogue.text: Is it white? I always separate white clothes from colored ones.

dialogue.speaker: Sister
dialogue.text: No, it's bright red. Here is the detergent.

dialogue.speaker: Brother
dialogue.text: Okay, just put it into the washing machine. Wait, please empty the pockets first!

dialogue.speaker: Sister
dialogue.text: Oops, thank you! I almost washed my keys.

story.text: A brother prepares to do his laundry. His sister asks him to wash her red shirt too. Because he always separates white clothes from colored ones, he agrees but reminds her to empty the pockets first so she doesn't accidentally wash her keys.

questions.question: What chore is the brother doing?
questions.suggested_answer: He is doing his laundry.

questions.question: What color is the sister's shirt?
questions.suggested_answer: It is bright red.

questions.question: Why does the brother ask about the color?
questions.suggested_answer: Because he always separates white clothes from colored ones.

questions.question: What does the sister find inside her pockets?
questions.suggested_answer: She finds her keys.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Brrr! It's absolutely freezing outside today.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yeah, I think it's only five degrees. Did you check the weather forecast?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, it says the sky will clear up by afternoon.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's good news. I hope it warms up a bit so we can go for a walk.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Me too, I hate staying indoors all day.

story.text: Two friends chat about the freezing weather outside. The temperature sits at only five degrees, but the weather forecast says that the sky will clear up by afternoon. They hope the air warms up a bit because they both hate staying indoors all day.

questions.question: What is the weather like outside?
questions.suggested_answer: It is absolutely freezing.

questions.question: What is the current temperature?
questions.suggested_answer: It is only five degrees.

questions.question: What does the weather forecast say about the afternoon?
questions.suggested_answer: It says the sky will clear up.

questions.question: Why do they want the weather to warm up?
questions.suggested_answer: Because they want to go for a walk and hate staying indoors.

vocabulary.meaning: Được miễn phí (do nhà hàng đãi)

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.text: Excuse me, waiter. I ordered this steak medium, but it's totally undercooked.

dialogue.speaker: Waiter
dialogue.text: Oh, I deeply apologize for that, sir. Let me take it back to the kitchen.

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.text: Thank you. My wife's food is great, but I can't eat this.

dialogue.speaker: Waiter
dialogue.text: We will replace it with a fresh one right away. And your drinks are on the house tonight.

dialogue.speaker: Guest
dialogue.text: Alright, that is very nice of you.

story.text: A restaurant guest complains that his steak is completely undercooked. The waiter apologizes sincerely and takes it back to the kitchen immediately. He promises to replace it with a fresh dish and offers the table free drinks on the house.

questions.question: What is wrong with the guest's steak?
questions.suggested_answer: It is totally undercooked.

questions.question: How did the guest want his steak cooked?
questions.suggested_answer: He ordered it medium.

questions.question: How does the waiter fix the problem?
questions.suggested_answer: He takes it back to replace it with a fresh one right away.

questions.question: What does the restaurant offer for free?
questions.suggested_answer: Their drinks are on the house tonight.
